text: Debugging is a normal part of programming. When your code does not work as expected, you need to find the bug, or mistake, that causes the problem. Good debugging starts with a clear understanding of what the code should do. Then you can look for where it goes wrong. Many developers use debugging tools that let them pause a program and check the values of variables. It is also helpful to take a systematic approach: test one part at a time instead of changing everything at once. Adding logging messages to your code is another simple and powerful way to see what is happening and find the source of the error.
